name: image_pattern_analysis
description: Analyze the visual pattern features of a local image file (jpg/png) using pure pixel statistics, fully offline: overall brightness & 4x4 brightness grid, dominant hue & main colors, brush-stroke/edge direction histogram (Sobel), texture density, highlight dot ratio, and horizontal symmetry, ending with composition suggestions. Use this when the user asks to extract the pattern/style features of a reference image (e.g. for UI button/icon design).

path.description: Absolute path to the image file (jpg/png)
